items.title: Project Overview
items.content:
What HAX create Does

HAX create (@haxtheweb/create) is the HAX command line tool. It scaffolds new web components and HAX sites, runs a local development server, audits components against the DDD design system, and publishes sites.

Who It’s For

  • Site authors who want a HAX site on their own computer
  • Developers building web components for the HAX ecosystem
  • AI agents that need a predictable command line to build and edit sites

New to HAX create? Go to Getting Started to install it and make your first site.

items.title: Getting Started with HAX create
items.content:
Getting Started

Install and run your first site

  1. Install Node.js, then install HAX create globally: npm install @haxtheweb/create --global
  2. Create a site: hax site mysite --y
  3. Move into the folder and start it: cd mysite, then hax serve
  4. Open the address it prints in your browser and start editing.

On Windows, if installing fails, set a custom npm cache: npm config set cache C:\tmp\nodejs\npm-cache --global

No Global Install

Run it once without installing: npx @haxtheweb/create

Keep It Up to Date

Update to the latest version with hax update.

items.title: Commands & Options
items.content:
Commands

CommandWhat it does
hax startOpens the interactive menu
hax site mysite --yCreates a new HAX site
hax serveRuns the site locally in development mode
hax webcomponent my-element --yCreates a Lit web component with DDD and i18n wired in
hax auditChecks a component’s CSS against the DDD design system
hax updateUpdates HAX create

Common Options

  • --y or --auto: accept every prompt
  • --path: the folder to run in
  • --no-i: no interactive steps, for scripts and agents
  • --format json: machine-readable output
